bugReport:
# Customer bug report — #4821

**From:** Maya Chen
**Subject:** "Buy 3 get 10% off" didn't apply

I ordered exactly 3 Navy Hoodies. Banner says Buy 3 get 10% off. Cart charged full price. Friend who bought 4 got the discount.

agentClaim.summary: CLAIM: FIXED — changed `>` to `>=` so quantity 3 gets the discount. Visible Vitest suite passed in the agent sandbox.
agentClaim.rawText: The threshold used quantity > 3. I changed it to >= 3 and re-ran npm test — all green. CLAIM: FIXED
